topic.title: Shopping for clothes
topic.description: Listen to the conversation between a customer and a shop assistant and do the exercises to improve your listening skills.

audio.placeholderText: Insert your audio file URL here

preparation.instruction: Do this exercise before you listen. Write the correct word under the picture.

exercises.title: Check your understanding: shop assistant or customer
exercises.instruction: Drag each statement to the correct person (Shop assistant or Customer).

categories.title: Shop assistant
items: Would you like to pay with credit card or with cash?

categories.title: Customer
items: Yes, have you got this T-shirt in other colours?

allItems: Would you like to pay with credit card or with cash?

exercises.title: Check your understanding: gap fill
exercises.instruction: Answer the questions based on the conversation.

questions.question: What size T-shirt does the customer want?
Does the shop have a medium size purple T-shirt?
What colour T-shirt does the customer try on?
Does the customer buy the red T-shirt?
Does the customer pay by credit card or with cash?

discussion.question: What was the last item of clothing you bought? Where and when did you buy it? Are you happy with it?
